params.prompt: A precise anatomical illustration of a single human lower molar tooth, sectioned vertically so the inside is visible. The outer enamel crown is white and glossy, the dentine beneath it warm ivory, and the pulp chamber and the two root canals running down through the roots are filled with warm gold that reads as metal. The tooth stands upright, seen from the side, its roots pointing down. Warm ivory dentine and glossy white enamel, with warm gold as the only other colour, on a pure white seamless background. Soft even studio light, fine natural surface texture, medical-museum quality, photoreal render. The object floats on pure white with NO cast shadow, NO contact shadow, NO reflection and no gradient behind it — the background is one flat pure white. No gums, no jawbone, no lips, no skin, no instruments, no hands. No text, no labels, no annotations, no watermark, no border.
